svg.title: Lifecycle — Encryptable
svg.desc: Three lanes. The first is the value round-trip: plaintext → typed envelope → random nonce + AES-256-GCM → base64 → stored → read back → try every key on the ring → type restored, with a return arrow noting that strict mode errors instead of handing back the input. The second lane shows the two DB query paths: filtering (preferred, parameter binding, the key never enters SQL, the index still works) and reading plaintext (the decrypt_expr fragment embeds the master key and lands in slow-query logs). The third lane is key rotation in four steps, with Locky's key ring: one gold primary key and two grey retired keys.
svg.text: value round-trip / the two DB query paths / key rotation in four steps
strict mode: failure is an error — never "return the input on failure"

g.text: let the database decrypt the column
plaintext on the wire and in RAM
new writes use the new key
old rows stay as they are

svg.text: the three keys on Locky's ring
rotation walks gold down to grey
while the old key is still on the ring, old ciphertext still opens
